The reward target on the right border rules out games where reward is randomly placed food or bricks at the top. The moving-object channel behaving like a ball crossing the interior, plus the agent being a vertical paddle on the left, fits Pong almost exactly. The border obstacle channel is just the wall border. The action set includes up/down, which are the only actions needed for a left-side vertical paddle.

Description: The agent controls the left paddle, moving it up and down to intercept the ball; it is rewarded when the ball reaches the right side past the opponent, and presumably penalized or loses reward if the ball reaches the left side.

Confidence: 93%
